applicabilityBasis.summary: fxUSD is marketed as a dollar-pegged decentralized stablecoin and minted against wstETH/WBTC through borrowing and leverage positions. Its documented peg-protection redemption is conditional and delivers dollar-valued crypto collateral, subject to a fee. No issuer obligation to redeem a fixed amount of national currency or a bank deposit was established, leaving payment-stablecoin applicability ambiguous.

genius.notes: Dollar-denominated crypto-collateral redemption does not establish statutory monetary-value redemption. Protocol operations and treasury are governed by a six-signature multisig with a public timelock and limited emergency controls, so decentralized branding alone is not treated as an issuerless legal determination. No legal issuer, GENIUS route or token-specific public authorization was established. The separate appreciating fxSAVE share receives its own assessment. Interface terms effective March 5, 2026 identify community contributors rather than a legal entity and exclude U.S. residents, citizens and agents. Those interface restrictions do not establish a GENIUS foreign exception or an EU exclusion, and they do not prove that governance participants cannot constitute an issuer.

Unpublished or confidential applications are outside this public-source conclusion.
